 fire={fire=50,water=50,nature=200,neutral=100,ghost=100},
 water={fire=200,water=50,nature=50,neutral=100,ghost=100},
 nature={fire=50,water=200,nature=50,neutral=100,ghost=100},
}
local function resolve(attacker, defender, skill)
 local atk = attacker.atk
 local alevel = attacker.level
 local crit_chance = attacker.crit_chance or 0
 local crit_mult = attacker.crit_mult or 150
 local pen_pct = attacker.pen_pct or 0
 local pen_flat = attacker.pen_flat or 0
 local dh = defender.hp
 local shield = defender.shield or 0
 local armor = defender.armor
 local dlevel = defender.level
 local delem = defender.element
 local resist = defender.resist or {}
 local guarding = defender.guarding or false
 local power = skill.power
 local selem = skill.element or 'physical'
 local hits = skill.hits or 1
 local td = skill.true_damage or false
 local seed = skill.seed or 0
 local hp = dh
 local absorbed = 0
 local crits = 0
 local resolved = 0
 local overkill = 0
 local killed = false
 local diff = clamp(alevel - dlevel, -10, 10)
 local r = clamp(resist[selem] or 0, -50, 80)
 local emult = (mt[selem] and mt[selem][delem]) or 100
 for k=1,hits do
  if hp <= 0 then break end
  local p = power - 20*(k-1); if p < 10 then p = 10 end
  local d = floor(atk * p / 100)
  d = floor(d * (100 + 3*diff) / 100)
  local crit = false
  if (seed + 17*k) % 100 < crit_chance then crit = true end
  if crit then crits = crits + 1; d = floor(d * crit_mult / 100) end
  local immune = false
  if not td then
   local pen = pen_pct
   if crit then pen = pen * 2 end
   if pen > 100 then pen = 100 end
   local ea = floor(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pen_flat
   if ea < 0 then ea = 0 end
   d = floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))
   if emult == 0 then immune = true end
   d = floor(d * emult / 100)
   d = floor(d * (100 - r) / 100)
  end
  if guarding then d = floor(d / 2) end
  if d < 1 then if immune then d = 0 else d = 1 end end
  resolved = resolved + 1
  local a = shield; if a > d then a = d end
  shield = shield - a
  local loss = d - a
  if a > 0 and shield == 0 then loss = floor(loss * 125 / 100) end
  absorbed = absorbed + a
  if loss >= hp then
   overkill = loss - hp
   hp = 0
   killed = true
  else
   hp = hp - loss
  end
 end
 return {damage = dh - hp, absorbed = absorbed, hp = hp, shield = shield, overkill = overkill, crits = crits, hits = resolved, killed = killed}
end

{"code":"logic_define('nearest_tower', function(name)
  local p = coreai_world_pos(name)
  if p == nil then return 'none' end
  local dmin = -1
  for k = 1, 8 do
    local tp = coreai_world_pos('Tower' .. k)
    if tp ~= nil then
      local dx = tp.x - p.x
      local dz = tp.z - p.z
      local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
      if dmin < 0 or d < dmin then dmin = d end
    end
  end
  if dmin < 0 then return 'none' end
  local lim = 1.01 * dmin
  for k = 1, 8 do
    local tp = coreai_world_pos('Tower' .. k)
    if tp ~= nil then
      local dx = tp.x - p.x
      local dz = tp.z - p.z
      if math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) <= lim + 1e-9 then return 'Tower' .. k end
    end
  end
  return 'none'
end)
logic_define('wall_for_bearing', function(b)
  b = b % 360
  if b < 0 then b = b + 360 end
  local Rmid = 13.858196
  local thr = math.deg(math.atan(1.5 / Rmid))
  local gy = {347.5, 167.5}
  local gn = {'Gate_North', 'Gate_South'}
  for i = 1, 2 do
    local d = math.abs(b - gy[i]) % 360
    if d > 180 then d = 360 - d end
    if d <= thr then return gn[i] end
  end
  for k = 1, 8 do
    local s = 10 + 45 * (k - 1)
    local e = s + 45
    local bb = b
    if bb < s then bb = bb + 360 end
    if bb >= s and bb < e then return 'Wall' .. k end
  end
  return 'Wall8'
end)
return 'ok'"}

  local nr = #grid

    local row = grid[r]
    for c = 1, nc do
      local ch = row:sub(c, c)
      if ch == 'S' then sr, sc = r, c end
      if ch == 'G' then gr, gc = r, c end
    end
  end
  local NS = nr * nc * 4
  local INF = 1e15
  local dist, act, done = {}, {}, {}
  for i = 1, NS do dist[i] = INF; act[i] = INF end
  local function idx(r, c, k) return ((r - 1) * nc + (c - 1)) * 4 + k end
  dist[idx(sr, sc, 0)] = 0
  act[idx(sr, sc, 0)] = 0
  local dirs = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}}
  while true do
    local best, bd, ba = nil, INF, INF
    for i = 1, NS do
      if not done[i] and dist[i] < INF then
        local d = dist[i]
        if d < bd or (d == bd and act[i] < ba) then
          best = i; bd = d; ba = act[i]
        end
      end
    end
    if not best then break end
    done[best] = true
    local k = (best - 1) % 4
    local cell = math.floor((best - 1) / 4)
    local r = math.floor(cell / nc) + 1
    local c = (cell % nc) + 1
    if r == gr and c == gc then

    for di = 1, 4 do
      local nrr = r + dirs[di][1]

          if ch == '<' and dirs[di][2] ~= -1 then ok = false end
          if ch == '^' and dirs[di][1] ~= -1 then ok = false end
          if ch == 'v' and dirs[di][1] ~= 1 then ok = false end
        end
        if ok then
          local add = 1
          if ch == '~' then add = 3 end
          local nk = k
          if ch == 'a' and k % 2 == 0 then nk = k + 1 end
          if ch == 'b' and k < 2 then nk = k + 2 end
          local ni = idx(nrr, ncc, nk)
          local nd = bd + add
          local na = ba + 1
          if nd < dist[ni] or (nd == dist[ni] and na < act[ni]) then
